metadata.description: Exercise the packaged project dialog with real pointer/keyboard input and cancel without persisting project changes. Starts on the target-owned Projects renderer.
metadata.name: desktop-project-dialog-input

evaluate.expression: (() => { const root=document.querySelector('[data-testid="projects-surface"]'); if(!root)throw new Error('Project workspace missing'); if(root.querySelector('[role=alert]'))throw new Error('Project surface has an error'); window.__nativeProjectLinks=[...root.querySelectorAll('a[href^="/projects/"]')].map(a=>a.getAttribute('href')); return {projectLinks:window.__nativeProjectLinks,heading:root.querySelector('h1')?.textContent};})()

(() => {const dialog=document.querySelector('[role="dialog"]');const input=dialog?.querySelector('[data-testid="projects-name-input"]');const submit=dialog?.querySelector('[data-testid="confirm-create-project"]');if(input?.value!=='Native input verification'||!submit||submit.disabled)throw new Error('Native text input or form validation did not respond');return {typedValue:input.value,submitEnabled:!submit.disabled,projectNotSubmitted:true};})()

(() => {const root=document.querySelector('[data-testid="projects-surface"]');const links=[...root.querySelectorAll('a[href^="/projects/"]')].map(a=>a.getAttribute('href'));if(JSON.stringify(links)!==JSON.stringify(window.__nativeProjectLinks))throw new Error('Unsaved dialog changed the project list');if(document.activeElement?.getAttribute('data-testid')!=='projects-create-button')throw new Error('Dialog did not restore keyboard focus');return {projectLinks:links,unchanged:true,focusRestored:true};})()
